title: Reduced and increased TTHM and HAA5 monitoring under subpart V: qualifying criteria, reduced schedules, conditions forcing a return, and carry-over from subpart L

conditions: Subpart V applies to community and nontransient noncommunity water systems that use a primary or residual disinfectant other than ultraviolet light, or deliver water treated with one (141.620(b))
exclusions: Transient noncommunity water systems are not subject to subpart V (141.620(b))

claims.subject: TTHM LRAA at all monitoring locations that qualifies a system for reduced monitoring
conditions: The source water annual average TOC level, before any treatment, must also be at or below 4.0 mg/L at each treatment plant treating surface water or ground water under the direct influence of surface water, based on monitoring under 141.132(b)(1)(iii) or 141.132(d) (claim.dbp.monitoring.reduced-increased.reduced-criterion-toc)
Only data collected under subpart V or subpart L may be used to qualify for reduced monitoring
The HAA5 criterion applies at the same time (claim.dbp.monitoring.reduced-increased.reduced-criterion-haa5)

claims.subject: Reduced TTHM and HAA5 monitoring schedule for subpart H systems, by population served
claims.value: Fewer than 500: monitoring may not be reduced; 500 to 3,300: per year, 1 TTHM and 1 HAA5 sample at the location and quarter of the highest single TTHM and HAA5 measurements, or 1 dual sample set if both occurred at the same location and quarter; 3,301 to 9,999: per year, 2 dual sample sets at those locations and quarters; 10,000 to 49,999: per quarter, 2 dual sample sets at the locations with the highest TTHM and highest HAA5 LRAAs; 50,000 to 249,999: per quarter, 4 dual sample sets at the two highest of each; 250,000 to 999,999: per quarter, 6 at the three highest of each; 1,000,000 to 4,999,999: per quarter, 8 at the four highest of each; 5,000,000 or more: per quarter, 10 at the five highest of each
conditions: Systems on quarterly monitoring take dual sample sets every 90 days (table note 1)
Subpart V applies to community and nontransient noncommunity water systems that use a primary or residual disinfectant other than ultraviolet light, or deliver water treated with one (141.620(b))
exclusions: Transient noncommunity water systems are not subject to subpart V (141.620(b))

claims.subject: Reduced TTHM and HAA5 monitoring schedule for ground water systems, by population served
claims.value: Fewer than 500: every third year, 1 TTHM and 1 HAA5 sample at the location and quarter of the highest single measurements, or 1 dual sample set if both occurred at the same location and quarter; 500 to 9,999: the same per year; 10,000 to 99,999: per year, 2 dual sample sets at those locations and quarters; 100,000 to 499,999: per quarter, 2 dual sample sets at the locations with the highest TTHM and highest HAA5 LRAAs; 500,000 or more: per quarter, 4 dual sample sets at the two highest of each
conditions: Systems on quarterly monitoring take dual sample sets every 90 days (table note 1)

claims.subject: What ends reduced TTHM and HAA5 monitoring
claims.value: An LRAA from quarterly monitoring at any location above 0.040 mg/L for TTHM or 0.030 mg/L for HAA5, an annual or less frequent sample at any location above 0.060 mg/L for TTHM or 0.045 mg/L for HAA5, or a source water annual average TOC above 4.0 mg/L at any plant treating surface water or ground water under the direct influence of surface water: the system resumes routine monitoring under 141.621, or begins increased monitoring if 141.625 applies
